db_bookseller.text: The Annals of the Four Masters! Ireland's history, year by year, from the Flood to 1616. Brother Mícheál Ó Cléirigh walked the country copying every old manuscript he could beg or borrow.
They wrote it all down because they could see the old Gaelic world ending around them. Which it was. Some books are written for fun. That one was written in a hurry.

db_reader.text: Listen to this, from the Annals: 'A great wind this year.' That's it. That's the whole entry. Very Donegal.
